title: Content locator
description: Where a content kind's content lives (ADR 0128). A path names a file the Resource owns, relative to its Resource file's directory, and requires a media type. A URL names content the Resource does not own: an external URL, or a picture in the aggregate's shared image store. Each kind narrows which forms and targets it accepts. Kind schemas apply unevaluatedProperties, so this schema does not close the object.

path.description: A relative POSIX path inside the Resource file's directory: one or more non-empty segments joined by single slashes, no leading or trailing slash, no backslash or NUL, and no . or .. segment.

mediaType.description: An RFC 6838 media type, type/subtype, without parameters. Media types compare case-insensitively, so either case is accepted.
